_intro: Example rows of the dynamic configuration layer's configs table, in the row shape go/config/model.go declares: key, scope ("system" or "tenant"), tenant_id (the empty string on a system-tier row), value, updated_by and updated_at. Every key shown here is a real declared item (docs/config-reference.md's dynamic table, generated from the same schema); the concrete values are illustrative, and the tenant ids are placeholders. How to read them: a read resolves the narrowest row the caller's context entitles it to -- a tenant-scoped request reads its tenant row, else the system row, else the schema default. A Sensitive item's value column holds base64(ciphertext) sealed by the host's config cipher (dbkit.Cipher over APP_CONFIG_KEY), never plaintext; whether a row is encrypted is decided by the schema's Sensitive flag at read time, never by a marker on the row. No row carries a marker on purpose: a marker would tell a table reader which columns are worth stealing. Writes publish config.item.changed with [redacted] markers in both value slots for a Sensitive item, and every Set is audit-recorded. UpdatedBy is the Actor of the last Set.

rows._comment: Platform-scope row: authn's minimum password length for every tenant (authn.password_min_length is an int item, so the stored value is its canonical string).
Tenant-scope override row: one tenant tightens its own minimum above the platform's system row; the empty-string-vs-tenant-id pair is what makes the primary key (key, scope, tenant_id) unique.

Sensitive platform row: authn.social.google.client_secret is a Sensitive string item. The value column holds base64(ciphertext) sealed under the host's cipher -- never the plaintext client secret. Its schema default is redacted ([redacted]) in the committed reference and on the event bus alike; the item is never served on the public endpoint.

Tenant-scope override of a sharing item: one tenant shortens its share-link default expiry below the platform default (sharing.default_expiry is a duration item; the value is the canonical duration string).

System row of the same sharing item: the platform-wide default most tenants read, shown so the resolution of the tenant row above is visible (tenant row wins for tenant-acme, every other tenant reads this row, and a tenant with neither row reads the schema default).
